_comment: Project-tracker projection mappings for /ql-sync-jira. Copy to jira.config.json (or let /ql-sync-jira create it on first run, discovering custom-field IDs). Commit jira.config.json — it holds NO secrets and NO auth. The projection flow is tracker-neutral behind a per-tracker adapter (see decisions/0046); Jira and Azure DevOps (the "ado" block below) are the adapters shipped. Jira has two transports (see decisions/0011): the Atlassian Remote MCP (OAuth, browser login — the default) or an API token (for customers who block third-party MCP OAuth but allow create-your-own tokens). The API token itself NEVER goes here — it comes from the JIRA_EMAIL/JIRA_API_TOKEN env vars.
_tracker: Which project-tracker adapter drives the projection: "jira" (default when absent) or "ado" (Azure DevOps Boards). A new tracker is a drop-in adapter per the contract in the ql-sync-jira skill's references/adapter-contract.md — no change to the sync flow. The top-level keys below (transport, base_url, project_key, issue_types, status_map, fields, labels) are Jira-adapter config; the Azure DevOps adapter reads only the "ado" block at the end. Keep the block for the tracker you use; the other is ignored.
_transport: Which pen /ql-sync-jira uses to write the SAME projection: "mcp" (Atlassian Remote MCP, OAuth) or "api" (Jira Cloud REST v3, API token via launchpad/scripts/jira-rest.mjs). /ql-setup probes MCP first and records the reachable one. Default "mcp".
_base_url: API transport ONLY — the customer's Jira site, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net. Omit/blank for the MCP transport (OAuth resolves the site). Non-secret; the token lives in JIRA_API_TOKEN, never here.
_issue_types: Jira issue-type NAMES for each projected level. Vary per project.
_status_map: Ledger status token (emoji) -> Jira workflow status NAME. Names are per-project. The repo/ledger is the only writer of delivery status — this just mirrors it.
_fields: Per-instance custom-field IDs (e.g. customfield_10014). /ql-sync-jira discovers these by field name from the issue type's field list; leave blank to let it fill them. scope_hash/intent_id are optional stamps — identity still works via the intent:<id> label without them. (No epic_link here: stories are linked to epics via the issue parent in the create call.)
_ado: Azure DevOps adapter config (tracker: "ado"). Tested on Azure DevOps Services. Azure DevOps Server may differ; it is untested. No secrets here either: the MCP transport signs in as you (az login / browser), and the API transport reads ADO_PAT (or ADO_TOKEN) from the environment.

ado._transport: "mcp" (the Azure DevOps MCP, @azure-devops/mcp — the default) or "api" (ADO REST via launchpad/scripts/ado-rest.mjs, with a PAT scoped to Work Items: Read & write and Project and Team: Read). Both draw the same projection (decisions/0011). /ql-setup records the reachable one.
ado._org_url: The organization (https://dev.azure.com/<org>) or an Azure DevOps Server collection (https://<host>/<collection>; untested). The API transport sends requests here; the MCP transport is launched with the org name, and this confirms it points at the same org.
ado._area_path: Optional. Where new items land, e.g. "Project\\Team A". Blank = the project's root area, which shows on the default team's backlog. A team only sees items under its own area paths.
ado._work_item_types: Type NAMES for each projected level. They depend on the project's process: the intent level is "User Story" (Agile), "Product Backlog Item" (Scrum), "Issue" (Basic) or "Requirement" (CMMI). In Agile, "Issue" is an impediment — not a story. Stories are parented straight to the Epic (the Feature level is skipped); new teams have the Epics backlog level off until Team settings → Backlogs turns it on.
ado._status_map: Ledger status token → a state CATEGORY (Proposed, InProgress, Resolved, Completed, Removed): the adapter sets the first state the type lists in that category, so one map fits every process. To pin an exact state name instead, use {"state": "<name>"} (e.g. {"state": "Resolved"} for 🔄 in Agile). Basic has no Removed category: 🚫 there gets the removed tag below plus a comment, reported as degraded.
ado._fields: Optional custom-field REFERENCE names (e.g. Custom.ScopeHash), found by display name via the discovery op. Blank = tag-only identity for that stamp.
ado._tags: Identity and signal tags. ADO tags are whole-value and case-insensitive, and can't contain ";".
